identification: E. Graeme Robertson and Edith N. Craig, Early Houses of Northern Tasmania, 2 vols, Georgian House, Melbourne 1964, limited edition no. 615 of 1,000 signed by both authors, in dust jackets. Later trade printings (c.1966) exist and are unsigned; this lot is the signed limited first edition.
